meta.method: All PDFs downloaded from arXiv (or publisher open-access copy where noted) and parsed with pypdf (default and layout modes) and pdfminer.six. Tables were machine-parsed from extracted text; every 'snippet' below was verified programmatically to occur verbatim (after whitespace normalisation and ligature expansion) in the extracted text of the cited PDF page. PDF math extraction sometimes scrambles superscripts/subscripts; where that happens the snippet is kept verbatim and the reading is given in 'snippet_reading'.
meta.pdf_page_convention: pdf_page = 1-based page index of the parsed PDF (arXiv version unless stated otherwise).
meta.working_dir: (local working folder; source PDFs not committed) (pdfs/, txt/)
